Process

How we work

No mystery, no surprises — here is exactly what happens from your first message.

Discovery call

We learn the guest count, budget range, dates and what matters most to both families.

Proposal & budget

A written scope, a realistic budget and a vendor shortlist you can react to.

Design & booking

Decor direction agreed, venues and vendors contracted, timelines circulated.

Production

Site recces, run sheets, rehearsals and every vendor briefed on the same schedule.

The celebration

Our team runs the day. Your family gets to be guests.

About

Banner & Bloom Events

We plan and produce weddings in Downtown, Austin — design, vendors, logistics and the day itself.

Our job is to make the complicated parts invisible. Budgets, vendor contracts, run sheets and the hundred small decisions that pile up — all handled, so the two of you can be present at your own wedding.

Questions

Before you get in touch

Do you take on partial planning?
Yes. Some couples want everything handled; others just want decor, or a team to run the day. Both work.
How does your fee work?
We quote against your scope and budget after the first call — no percentage surprises once vendors are booked.
Do you handle destination weddings?
Yes, including guest logistics, room blocks and local vendor sourcing at the destination.
Can we keep vendors we've already booked?
Of course. We'll fold them into the schedule and brief them the same as anyone we bring in.
What's the fastest way to reach you?
WhatsApp. Tap the button anywhere on this page and your message comes straight to us.
